bottom_line: The ratings mostly still hold on their merits, but tonight is a poor night to start positions: Nasdaq futures are down about 0.7-0.8% and Nvidia reports Tuesday after the close, the first named risk in today's worldview. Waiting one or two sessions for Nvidia's reaction costs little against the overweight-only ratings.
what_changed: Nasdaq-100 futures -0.7% to -0.8%, S&P futures -0.2% to -0.3%, Dow roughly flat; tech leads the weakness (touches 'AI trade is crowded at high rates').
Nvidia fell more than 2% in early trading on reports Jensen Huang may return; results are due Tuesday after the close (touches the Nvidia key-person thesis and the top worldview risk).
Anthropic's IPO is expected Thursday, a second binary event this week for AI valuations.
No after-hours earnings from AI suppliers since Friday's close were found.
